newsitem.title: USA: Computer Integration completes stock sale.
newsitem.headline: Computer Integration completes stock sale.

text.p: Computer Integration Corp said Thursday it had completed the sale of 6.95 million shares of its common stock for $7,436,500 to third parties.
The company said buyers now hold 49.86 percent of the shares of its common stock outstanding.

In connection with the sale, Computer Integration said, Chartwell Group Inc, which facilitated the deal, was issued a seven-year warrant to buy 300,000 additional shares of Computer Integration stock for $1.13 a share.
Also as part of the deal, the company's board has increased from four to six members.
Additionally, the company said Chief Operating Officer Stephen Wright and Chief Financial Officer Edward Meltzer have both signed new employment agreements.
Computer Integration is a reseller of microcomputers, workstations and related products.
